THE FIRST DAY

Make yourself at home

Explore

W A S D move · mouse look
SPACE jump · SHIFT sprint
E inventory · 1–9 hotbar
Double SPACE or F to fly in Creative · Q drop
M map · T commands

Mine & build

Hold the left mouse button to break a block. Right-click to place or use the item in your hand. A pickaxe is needed for ore. Use tools made of stronger materials to mine faster.

Craft & survive

Start with wood. Open your inventory and use the recipe book to craft planks, sticks, and a crafting table. Place the table and right-click it for a 3 × 3 grid. Build a shelter before night.

A living world

Find villages, trade with villagers, farm crops, cook in a furnace, and sleep in a bed. Fill a bucket at water. Explore outposts, Nether fortresses and bastions. Brew potions with water bottles, Nether wart and blaze fuel. Craft Eyes of Ender to find a stronghold, fill its 12 frames, then destroy End crystals and defeat the dragon. Hostile creatures appear at night.

Desktop: click the world to capture your mouse. Escape releases it. On touch screens, drag the right side to look. This is a playable subset of Minecraft, with original generated textures.
